shoulder_yaw_deg.method: trail->lead shoulder joint centres, projected to the ground [right_shoulder -> left_shoulder]

shoulder_open_deg.method: trail->lead shoulder joint centres, projected to the ground [right_shoulder -> left_shoulder]; positive = open

pelvis_yaw_deg.method: trail->lead hip joint centres, projected to the ground [right_hip -> left_hip]

pelvis_open_deg.method: trail->lead hip joint centres, projected to the ground [right_hip -> left_hip]; positive = open

knee_center_yaw_deg.method: trail->lead knee joint centres, projected to the ground (a line through the knee centres, not kneecap direction) [right_knee -> left_knee]

knee_center_open_deg.method: trail->lead knee joint centres, projected to the ground (a line through the knee centres, not kneecap direction) [right_knee -> left_knee]; positive = open

stance_yaw_deg.method: trail->lead toe line (big toes, else shoe toe-contact points), projected to the ground [right_big_toe -> left_big_toe]

stance_open_deg.method: trail->lead toe line (big toes, else shoe toe-contact points), projected to the ground [right_big_toe -> left_big_toe]; positive = open

lead_foot_flare_deg.method: lead foot heel->toe on the ground, from square (perpendicular to the target line, toward the ball); positive = toe turned out [left_heel -> left_big_toe]

trail_foot_flare_deg.method: trail foot heel->toe on the ground, from square (perpendicular to the target line, toward the ball); positive = toe turned out [right_heel -> right_big_toe]

club.impact_time_basis: P7 marks the frame containing or nearest impact: true impact within one frame interval of its time

clubhead_speed_m_s.method: quadratic least-squares fit of the tracking centre over ±10 ms of impact; derivative at impact; impact time ±4.17 ms (P7 frame), so timing_uncertainty includes the change over that interval

clubhead_speed_mph.method: quadratic least-squares fit of the tracking centre over ±10 ms of impact; derivative at impact; impact time ±4.17 ms (P7 frame), so timing_uncertainty includes the change over that interval

path_yaw_deg.method: quadratic least-squares fit of the tracking centre over ±10 ms of impact; derivative at impact; impact time ±4.17 ms (P7 frame), so timing_uncertainty includes the change over that interval; ground direction, +Y positive

club_path_deg.method: quadratic least-squares fit of the tracking centre over ±10 ms of impact; derivative at impact; impact time ±4.17 ms (P7 frame), so timing_uncertainty includes the change over that interval; positive = in-to-out

attack_angle_deg.method: quadratic least-squares fit of the tracking centre over ±10 ms of impact; derivative at impact; impact time ±4.17 ms (P7 frame), so timing_uncertainty includes the change over that interval; elevation, negative = descending

swing_direction_deg.method: total-least-squares plane through the tracking centre over ±40 ms of impact; its horizontal line toward the target; positive = right of target (RH)

swing_plane_inclination_deg.method: total-least-squares plane through the tracking centre over ±40 ms of impact; its horizontal line toward the target

low_point_ahead_of_ball_m.method: lowest usable tracking-centre sample in [-30, 60] ms of impact, bracketed by samples on both sides; uncertainty includes half the sample spacing

low_point_height_m.method: lowest usable tracking-centre sample in [-30, 60] ms of impact, bracketed by samples on both sides; uncertainty includes half the sample spacing (tracking centre, not the sole)

low_point_time_ms.method: lowest usable tracking-centre sample in [-30, 60] ms of impact, bracketed by samples on both sides; uncertainty includes half the sample spacing; relative to the P7 time

fitted_arc_low_point_ahead_of_ball_m.method: circle fitted in its plane to usable pre-impact samples in [-40, -3] ms (the free arc before contact); its lowest point. A model extrapolation, distinct from the observed low point
reasons: fitted circle radius 1.60 m, residual 0.7 mm

observed_low_point.method: lowest usable tracking-centre sample in [-30, 60] ms of impact, bracketed by samples on both sides; uncertainty includes half the sample spacing

fitted_free_arc_low_point.method: circle fitted in its plane to usable pre-impact samples in [-40, -3] ms (the free arc before contact); its lowest point. A model extrapolation, distinct from the observed low point
reasons: fitted circle radius 1.60 m, residual 0.7 mm
